title: Arrakis report: 76% of enterprise agents sit dormant with live credentials. I build agent governors — here's the finding that worries me most
description: The Arrakis 2026 Autonomous Agents Threat Report reveals that a significant majority of enterprise autonomous agents remain dormant yet retain active credentials, posing security risks. Notably, 76% of agents have not run in 60 days but still have valid credentials and active triggers. Additionally, 24% of dormant agents can be activated externally via unsigned webhooks, and 20% can delegate tasks to other agents with higher permissions, potentially bypassing intended access controls. The report highlights a common operational gap where agent credentials and approvals are not revoked or expired after inactivity, unlike employee access which is promptly removed upon departure.
